about: The words of each place's newsroom page (newsroom/build/features/viz-newsroom.mjs). Kept by viz.places@PrompTugal.dinis. {name} is the place, the other {fields} are computed from the record.
title: The newsroom of PrompTugal.news {name}
summary: How the page of {name} is made, end to end and from the record: {sources} sources read, {items} entries captured with their read dates, each put to the PrompTugal test, written up, checked and signed, and released {releases} times since {first}.
lede: One agent, place.{id}@, runs the research and publish loop for {name}: it reads the public sources, captures each find with its link and the date it read it, puts it to the PrompTugal test (about AI directly, or within two or three steps, the path written down), writes it into the place's file and signs the file with the site's own key. The gate checks every release; CI numbers and deploys it. Everything below is read from the record at this release.

lines.pages_read: {n} web pages read in its runs (run reports)
lines.screens: screenshots: not yet (data.places@ builds the capture vault)
lines.sections: mandate, centre of gravity, local news, AI map, events, sources, gaps
lines.gate: the gate: schema, sources, read dates, AI paths, banned hosts
lines.ci: CI numbers, builds, gates and deploys
lines.screens_n: captured: {n} of {of} pages, screenshot and text hashed in data.places@'s vault

who.check: the gate and abp@'s identity check

run_intro: Every commit to the place's file, oldest first: who made it, what changed, and the release that shipped it.
h_items: Every entry, from capture to page
items_intro: Each story and map entry on the page today: where it was read and when, its path to AI, the commit that brought it in and the release that put it live.
gaps_intro: Written down by the agent in its file and its status, so the gaps are part of the record too.
chart_aria: The place's file growing, commit by commit: stories, AI map entries and sources
chart_legend: The file growing, commit by commit, from {from} to {to} UTC
items_cols: | Entry | Kind | Read at | Read on | AI path | Came in | Live in |
h_towns: Every town's newsroom, side by side
towns_intro: The same loop, run by one agent per town. Each row is read from that town's file and its git history at this release; follow a name to see its newsroom at work.
towns_cols: | Town | Agent | Now | Sources | Captured | Pass the test | Releases | Last change |
agentmap_aria: The Algarve's place agents on the map, each at its town, its face by the same rule as everywhere on the site
agentmap_caption: Each town's agent at its town, as of the last commit on record ({asof} UTC): {now} of {count} at work in the last 90 minutes. The face follows the site's one rule; follow a town to its newsroom. Coast and border: Natural Earth (public domain).
h_agentmap: The region's agents, on the map
h_blast: The blast radius: what reaches {name} from around it
blast_intro: Rings at 10, 25 and 50 km from {name}. A line joins it to each council it borders. Each other town is drawn by how many of its stories reach {name} under the site's rule: a story marked for its neighbours travels to the councils its town borders and to anything within 20 km; one marked for the region travels to every Algarve town; one marked local stays home.
blast_aria: The blast radius of {name}: rings at 10, 25 and 50 km, the councils it borders, and how many stories reach it from each town
blast_caption: Stories reaching {name} from the towns around it: {shown}, from {from} of them; {unmarked} of the region's stories are not yet marked with their significance. Borders and distances: data.places@ (pt.wikipedia at named revisions, read {read}; a check against the official map, CAOP, is owed).
blast_twin: - {name}, {km} km{border}: {n} of its stories reach here
tree_intro: Every story carries how far it matters: its town, its neighbours, the region, the country, beyond. Each bar is a place's stories by that mark, as its agent set it; a story travels up the tree as far as its mark allows.
h_agentmap_pt: The country's place agents, on the map
nowmap_intro: Live from public sources, read hourly by the site's own collector with no model. In each circle: the temperature now at the town's nearest IPMA station where it reports one (a filled circle), or else today's forecast high (an open circle); beneath, today's forecast low and high and the chance of rain. Above the map, IPMA's warnings for the Faro district; near Faro, the airline flights adsb.lol's receivers saw around the airport. Every mark opens the page it comes from or the town's newsroom.
nowmap_aria: Today's IPMA forecast for each Algarve town: high and low temperature and chance of rain
nowmap_caption: Stations read {obs} UTC, forecast for {date}, read from IPMA at {read} UTC; each town uses its nearest IPMA station and forecast place. Flights: adsb.lol, within {nm} nautical miles of Faro airport at {fat} UTC. Not a warning service: follow IPMA (ipma.pt) and ANEPC.
nowmap_warn: IPMA warnings for the Faro district: {list}.
nowmap_twin: - {name}: {now}forecast {min}° to {max}°, {rain}% chance of rain (forecast for {fplace}, {km} km away)
h_arcs: Connected: shared borders and sourced links
arcs_intro: Grey lines join councils that share a border. Red arcs join two towns that a sourced connection links: a company, a body or a project in one working with one in the other, each found and read by the detective and the place agents. Hover an arc for what it is; follow it to its source.
arcs_aria: The Algarve towns joined by shared borders (grey) and by sourced connections between them (red)
arcs_caption: {borders} shared borders (data.places@, pt.wikipedia at named revisions; the CAOP check is owed) and {arcs} sourced links between towns, from {links} connections in data/by-place/connections.json (detective.places@ and the place agents, each with its source and read date).
nowmap_warn_none: IPMA: no warnings for the Faro district
